items.question: In what condition are beings situated within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings are located within these womb-diagrams.
These beings are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are in a state of torment.
uncertainties: The specific subjects who are tormented are not explicitly named in this verse and rely on prior context.
